name: producthunt
description: Product Hunt integration for discovering, searching, and analyzing products, topics, collections, and user profiles via the Product Hunt GraphQL API.

description.en: Product Hunt integration for discovering, searching, and analyzing products, topics, collections, and user profiles via the Product Hunt GraphQL API.
description.zh-cn: Product Hunt 集成，通过 GraphQL API 发现、搜索和分析产品、主题、合集与用户信息。
description.ja: Product Hunt GraphQL API を通じて製品、トピック、コレクション、ユーザー情報の検索・分析を行う統合プラグインです。

interface.longDescription: Search and analyze products, topics, collections, and user profiles on Product Hunt. Supports trending products, topic-based filtering, date-range queries, and detailed product insights including votes, comments, and maker information.
defaultPrompt: Show me today's top products on Product Hunt
Search for AI tools launched this week on Product Hunt
Get details about a specific product on Product Hunt
